portrait-ink.$description: Portrait Ink — Primary text, heading strokes, outlined action borders — the single deep navy that holds the entire type and structural line system

nautical-teal.$description: Nautical Teal — Secondary brand ink for nav strokes, icons, and accent text where Ink feels too heavy

rainbow-spectrum.$description: Rainbow Spectrum — Supporting palette color for small decorative accents when the core palette needs contrast. Do not promote it to the primary CTA color

lavender-violet.$description: Lavender Violet — Decorative spectrum color — appears only as part of the rainbow gradient, never as a standalone fill

cobalt-pop.$description: Cobalt Pop — Decorative spectrum color — appears only as part of the rainbow gradient composition

grape-vibrant.$description: Grape Vibrant — Decorative spectrum color — appears only as part of the rainbow gradient composition

cherry-red.$description: Cherry Red — Decorative spectrum color — appears only as part of the rainbow gradient composition

tangerine-warm.$description: Tangerine Warm — Decorative spectrum color — appears only as part of the rainbow gradient composition

sunflower-yellow.$description: Sunflower Yellow — Decorative spectrum color — appears only as part of the rainbow gradient composition

leaf-green.$description: Leaf Green — Decorative spectrum color — appears only as part of the rainbow gradient composition

charcoal-outline.$description: Charcoal Outline — Universal stroke and heavy text color — every hairline border, icon outline, and default UI line lives here

graphite-body.$description: Graphite Body — Body text and icon strokes where Portrait Ink feels too cool — slightly warmer reading tone

slate-helper.$description: Slate Helper — Muted helper text, secondary nav text, and decorative borders that should recede behind primary ink

iron-quiet.$description: Iron Quiet — Quiet icon strokes and low-emphasis nav accents

ash-divider.$description: Ash Divider — Light dividers and structural hairlines on neutral surfaces

fog-edge.$description: Fog Edge — Disabled state borders and placeholder strokes

mist-hairline.$description: Mist Hairline — Card surface tint and the lightest possible structural divider

white-canvas.$description: White Canvas — Page background and the universal surface above which all color floats

mint-wash.$description: Mint Wash — Soft pastel surface tint used on badge chips and small highlighted areas

sky-wash.$description: Sky Wash — Soft section background, alternate surface, and quiet card fill

peach-wash.$description: Peach Wash — Soft pastel surface tint used on warm-accent chips and highlighted areas

switzer.$description: Universal body and UI face — paragraphs, buttons, nav, links, tags, helper text, and small display moments. Reads neutral, geometric, and friendly. The 0.14em tracked all-caps variant at 10–11px is reserved for tiny eyebrow labels and New badges.

basier-circle.$description: Headline and hero voice only — reserved for the largest statements and key brand moments. The dramatic negative tracking at 76px (about -4.25px) pulls characters together so multi-line headlines lock into a tight block rather than a loose stack. Mixed with Switzer for subhead and body.
